_about: Inputs for tools/power_budget.py. Edit values here and re-run: python3 tools/power_budget.py. Every entry carries its source; 'estimate' means no vendor figure exists and the value should be replaced by a bench measurement.
_rail_5v_v: Boost output set by R14/R15 (240 kΩ / 75 kΩ) and VREF 1.204 V (TPS61088 data sheet, PWM mode; the design runs forced PWM).
_battery_nominal_v: Cell nominal voltage, Soldered 333288 / 333290 datasheets. Used for energy (Wh) and for average battery current.
_usable_fraction: Share of rated capacity used before the TLV840 supervisor (2.9 V on VSYS) switches the load off. Rated capacity is measured down to 2.5 to 3.0 V at 0.2 C; the last few percent below 3.0 V are lost. Estimate.
_aged_capacity_fraction: End-of-life capacity (cell data sheets: at least 80 % after the rated cycle count). Used for the conservative runtime column.
_boost_efficiency_curve: TPS61088 efficiency vs 5 V output current. TI data sheet SLVSCM8D Figure 6-2 (VIN 3.6 V, VOUT 5 V, forced PWM) minus 2 points for a switching frequency of about 1 MHz and the CKST0603 inductor DCR (15.5 mΩ). Linear interpolation between points. The board switches at about 720 kHz (R16 220 kΩ), so the curve is about 1 point pessimistic. tools/power_budget.py uses it as is; hardware/sim/run_heat.py rescales the switching loss and gives the simulated efficiency.
_path_resistance_ohm: Battery to boost input: JST-PH contacts (about 2 x 10 mΩ), fuse F1 Littelfuse 0466005.NRHF 5 A (11 mΩ nominal), MAX77757 BATT-to-SYS switch (20 mΩ typ), traces. Estimate.
_load_switch_ron_ohm: TPS22975 on-resistance at VBIAS 5 V, TI data sheet typical.
_battery_side_quiescent_ma: Currents on the battery/VSYS side while running, in addition to the boost: MAX77757 battery-only 0.030 mA (typ, 0.050 max), MAX17048 active 0.023 mA, boost feedback divider 240 kΩ + 75 kΩ at 5 V 0.016 mA, R10 1 MΩ thermostat 0.004 mA, TLV840 0.0002 mA, boost VIN quiescent (included in efficiency). Rounded up.

max.source: MAX77757 battery-only quiescent, typ and max

ti.name: BQ25798 battery-only, ADC off
ti.source: BQ25798 IQ_BAT_ON (data sheet condition VBAT 8 V)

ti.name: U14, Q11, Q12, TS divider, LED pull-ups
ti.source: PMID and REGN are unpowered without USB, SW_EN is grounded, STAT and Q10 are open

_off_state: Battery drain with the POWER slider off and no USB, per board. ua: [typ, max] µA from the data sheets. Resistor paths are computed from the cell voltage: (V - drop) / R, max with R at -1 % and the smaller drop. See docs/power.md, off-state budget.

loads_5v.source: TCA9534: at most 4 uA standby at 3.6 V plus 2 x 33 uA in 100 kOhm pulls at 3.3 V; rounded to 0.1 mA for polling. Each additional grounded spare input adds 33 uA. Estimate, through display LDO.

gnss.via: ADSBee J4 3.3 V output (assumed linear regulator: 5 V input current = 3.3 V load current)
gnss._module: u-blox MAX-M10S data sheet UBX-20035208 R02, Table 13, GPS+GAL+GLO: tracking 7.0 + 2.3 mA (VCC + V_IO), acquisition 9.0 + 2.3 mA at 3.0 V
gnss._breakout_led_ma: SparkFun GPS-18037 power LED; PPS LED blinks only with fix. Estimate.
gnss._active_antenna_ma: Abracon AANE-AP-0164 LNA, 15 to 25 mA at 3.0 to 5.0 V, maximum used (datasheets/abracon-aane-ap-0164.pdf). Set 0 for a passive antenna.

charging._charge_current_a: MAX77757 IFAST: R6 + R37 = 6.2 kΩ + 6.2 kΩ in series = 12.4 kΩ (1 %, Basic C4260 each); data sheet Table 3 gives 1.8 A nominal, top-off 75 mA.
charging._charger_efficiency: Charging-path efficiency of the carrier-max-charger MAX77757, 1.3 MHz buck at 5 V in, about 3.8 V out, 1 to 2 A. Estimate: the data sheet publishes no efficiency curve. The heat model gives 90.3 % at 1.4 A in (device off) and 86 to 87 % at 2.5 A in with the device running (hardware/sim/heat/max/results.md).

max.label: carrier-max-charger, MAX77757
max.note: 1.8 A from the IFAST resistors, no host

ti.label: carrier-ti-charger, BQ25798
ti.note: 1.8 A set by the ESP32-S3 over I2C, 1 A in default mode without a host

charging._variants: Per board variant. BQ25798 efficiency from data sheet Figure 6-1 (750 kHz, VBUS 5 V, VBAT 4 V): 95 % at 1 to 1.5 A, 94 % at 2 A; the heat model gives 89 to 91 % with the system load on (hardware/sim/heat/ti/results.md).
charging._cv_tail_hours_per_ah: Constant-voltage phase after the constant-current phase until termination. Rule of thumb for LiPo at 0.2 to 0.5 C. Estimate.
charging._cc_fraction: Share of capacity delivered in the constant-current phase. Estimate.
